prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Action Playground Screen: Adds a dedicated pet playground screen after the home intro where users practice dragging, feeding, and hiding their desktop companion before completing setup. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple tickets complaining about lack of clarity on how to control or hide the pet after setup.)
1: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Engine Wait Checklist: Replaces the waiting screen background task display with an explicit multi-part progress checklist for desktop engine initialization. (why: The waiting stage takes a mean time of 2336s and users report issues with pets not displaying on desktop during initial setup.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Story Companion Path Feature Badges: Adds visual feature badges to the intro story screen highlighting companion capabilities before decision making. (why: The mean duration on choose_path is 514s, indicating users need earlier clarity on pet capabilities.)
3: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Account Persistence Banner: Adds an account persistence notification banner on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in locks pet data to their profile. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost or reset pets when re-logging, causing hesitation during sign_in (77.0% conversion).)

scores.note: Addresses the largest dropoff step (35.2%) with supporting feedback, but requires a brand-new screen.
Home step already converts high (91.9%), though evidence strongly supports resolving wait time confusion.
Target step loses 20.9% with long dwell time, though evidence relies only on funnel metrics without direct support logs.
Addresses 23.0% sign-in drop backed by explicit support email complaints with low implementation cost.
